caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, happy, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
We're hungry! Snack time!

[Chorus]
Yummy, yummy, yummy in my tummy,
Fruit is sweet and fruit is funny!
Crunch it, munch it, one, two, three,
Yummy fruit for you and me!

[Verse]
Rory picks a banana, long and yellow,
Peel it, peel it, what a funny fellow!
Munch, munch, one, two, three,
Banana for Rory, yum yum yummy!

[Chorus]
Yummy, yummy, yummy in my tummy,
Fruit is sweet and fruit is funny!
Crunch it, munch it, one, two, three,
Yummy fruit for you and me!

[Verse]
Ziggy picks some strawberries red,
Little seeds on top, she said!
Nibble, nibble, one, two, three,
Strawberries for Ziggy, yum yum yummy!

[Chorus]
Yummy, yummy, yummy in my tummy,
Fruit is sweet and fruit is funny!
Crunch it, munch it, one, two, three,
Yummy fruit for you and me!

[Verse]
Waffles picks a big green apple,
Crunch, crunch, crunch, he gives a chuckle!
Crunch, crunch, one, two, three,
Apple for Waffles, yum yum yummy!

[Chorus]
Yummy, yummy, yummy in my tummy,
Fruit is sweet and fruit is funny!
Crunch it, munch it, one, two, three,
Yummy fruit for you and me!

[Verse]
Pebble picks some blueberries blue,
Tiny and round, he eats a few!
Pop, pop, one, two, three,
Blueberries for Pebble, yum yum yummy!

[Bridge]
Banana! Strawberry! Apple! Blueberry!
Fruit makes us strong and fruit makes us merry!
Banana! Strawberry! Apple! Blueberry!
Rub your tummy, yum yum yummy!

[Chorus]
Yummy, yummy, yummy in my tummy,
Fruit is sweet and fruit is funny!
Crunch it, munch it, one, two, three,
Yummy fruit for you and me!

[Chorus]
Yummy, yummy, yummy in my tummy,
Fruit is sweet and fruit is funny!
Crunch it, munch it, one, two, three,
Yummy fruit for you and me!

[Outro]
Yummy! Bye bye, friends!
